description: Start or resume playback. Optionally target specific content.

context_uri.description: Spotify URI for an album, artist, or playlist

device_id.description: Target device ID; uses active device if omitted

dry_run.description: Preview only: describe what would change without performing it. Default false — pass true to preview.

offset.description: Index within an album/playlist context to start from. Ignored for ad-hoc uris; not valid for artist contexts (use offset_uri instead).

offset_uri.description: Track URI inside the context to start from — required for artist contexts, where a numeric index is rejected

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

uris.description: Up to 100 track/episode URIs to play as an ad-hoc queue

name: play
